buildNotes:
This build includes the following changes:
- Firebase authentication replaces NextAuth (magic link, Google, admin password, session cookies with ID-token fallback)
- Security and performance audit: Paystack insert-first idempotency, atomic AI billing debits, CSRF on session and AI routes, SSRF hardening for profile URLs, safe login redirects
- Query caps on schools, professor emails, documents, content versions, collaboration, and scheduled notification cron
- School import upsert with unique (userId, name, program); admin analytics use SQL counts instead of full-table scans
- Dashboard hydration fix for dismissible urgent strip and getting-started card
- Onboarding: searchable country picker and optional research interests
- Run `pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy` for migration 20260602120000_school_user_name_program_unique
